op.description:
The operation this patch will perform on the specified path.
See {@link K8sResource.PatchOperationType} for the supported patch operations.

path.description: The specified path in the resource YAML file to apply the patch to.

value.description:
Depending on the operation type, the value to write to the specified path.
If the patch operation type is one that does specify a value, do not provide one
when creating a K8sPatchOperation object.

title: Represents a patch operation on a K8s resource.
name: K8sPatchOperation
